description: Slow-moving capacity and write-rate trends, for spotting a disk filling up weeks before it becomes an incident. Prometheus is capped at 15 days and 8 GiB, so its own footprint should plateau rather than grow without bound.

panels.description: On-disk size of the Prometheus TSDB including its write-ahead log. Retention is capped at 15 days and 8 GiB, so this should level off rather than climb indefinitely.
panels.title: Prometheus disk footprint

panels.description: Bytes written per second per host. Useful for confirming that a nightly backup actually ran, and for spotting a runaway writer.
panels.title: Host write rate

panels.description: Free space on the root and /srv filesystems over time. The slope matters more than the value - a steady decline gives weeks of warning before anything fills.
panels.title: Available storage trend

title: Storage and Capacity Trends
